paper_title: Thinking Slow, Fast Scaling Inference Compute with Distilled Reasoners
caption: : Coverage.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates how coverage varies as the number of completions is increased, with four model/settings shown. The x-axis is labeled “Number of completions (k)” and uses discrete tick labels formatted as powers of two from \(2^0\) through \(2^8\) (spanning 1 to 256 completions), with one plotted point at each of these ticks. The y-axis is labeled “Coverage,” shown on a linear scale with visible gridlines and labeled ticks at approximately 0.4, 0.6, and 0.8 (the plotted values range from roughly the mid-0.2s up to just above 0.9). The “Llama-3B” series is a blue solid line with circular markers that increases steadily across the x-axis, starting near 0.42 at \(2^0\) and ending a little above 0.9 by \(2^8\). The “Llama-3B + FT” series is a green dotted line with upward-pointing triangle markers that also increases monotonically, beginning around 0.44 at \(2^0\) and reaching a bit above 0.9 by \(2^8\). The “Llama-1B” series is a lighter blue solid line with circular markers that rises throughout, starting around 0.25 at \(2^0\) and ending just under 0.9 at \(2^8\). The “Llama-1B + FT” series is a light green dotted line with upward-pointing triangle markers that similarly climbs from just under 0.3 at \(2^0\) to the mid-to-high 0.8s by \(2^8\), with no visible declines in any series.
